fields.label: Model Backend
fields.description: GGUF is 3-5x faster on CPU and uses less RAM. Transformers is the original slower backend, kept as a fallback / for easy A-B comparison.

fields.label: Local LLM Model
fields.description: Used only when Model Backend = Transformers (PyTorch). Any transformers-compatible causal LM.

fields.label: Embedding Model
fields.description: Upgraded default: all-mpnet-base-v2 gives noticeably better semantic separation than MiniLM, which improves both agent routing accuracy and RAG retrieval quality. Any sentence-transformers model works.

fields.label: GGUF Repo (Hugging Face)
fields.description: Official pre-quantized GGUF repo to auto-download from. Ignored if GGUF Model Path is set manually (e.g. from the standalone convert_to_gguf.py script for a custom model).

fields.label: GGUF Filename
fields.description: Exact filename within the repo above. q4_k_m is recommended: ~320MB, good quality, works on 512MB+ RAM.

fields.label: GGUF Model Path (override)
fields.description: Optional. Leave blank to auto-download the repo/filename above via warm_up_models. Set this to point at a custom .gguf file instead (e.g. output of scripts/convert_to_gguf.py).

fields.label: Chat Format
fields.description: Prompt template used by llama-cpp-python. Qwen models use ChatML -- leave as chatml unless you swap in a model with a different template.

fields.label: Hugging Face Token
fields.description: Optional. Without this, model downloads work but are rate-limited and show an 'unauthenticated requests' warning. Get a free token at huggingface.co/settings/tokens. Can also be set via the HF_TOKEN environment variable instead.

fields.label: Agent Caller GGUF Path
fields.description: Path to a GGUF model fine-tuned for function calling, e.g. LFM2.5-1.2B-Nova-Function-Calling. This is a separate model from the main chat GGUF above -- it needs to be good at emitting structured JSON, not at conversational answers. Leave blank to use the default location under this site's private files/frappe_ai/models/.

fields.label: Agent Caller System Prompt
fields.default:
You are a function-calling assistant for a Frappe/ERPNext system.

Available functions:
{{FUNCTIONS}}

Notes:
- Each item in "items" must be an object with "item_name" and "qty" (an
  integer). The user may say "quantity" or "qty" in plain English -- both
  map to the "qty" field.

When the user's request matches one of the functions above, respond with
ONLY a single JSON object, for example:
{"name": "create_sales_invoice", "arguments": {"customer": "Jane", "items": [{"item_name": "Keyboard", "qty": 3}], "due_date": "2026-08-01"}}

Do not use Python list / tool_call_start syntax. Do not include any other
text, explanation, or markdown formatting -- JSON only.
fields.description: Editable from the Desk. Must contain the literal token {{FUNCTIONS}} somewhere -- it gets replaced at runtime with the live JSON description of all enabled Agent Function records. Leave blank to use the built-in default.
